events.description: Called with the new list of chosen keys each time the selection changes.
events.name: onChange

events.description: Called with the key of every action chosen, after the action's own `onPress`.
events.name: onAction

events.description: Called with the new state each time the overlay opens or closes, from its trigger, a dismissal or the app.
events.name: onOpenChange

props.description: The element that opens the menu, usually a `Button` or `IconButton`; it must be pressable and named.
props.name: children

props.description: The groups of actions, in order, with a divider between them.
props.name: sections

props.description:
What choosing an action does: just run it (`none`, the default), or also keep it chosen, one per section
(`single`) or any number (`multiple`). A chosen action shows a mark and is reported in `onChange`.
props.name: selectionMode

props.description: The keys of the chosen actions, for a controlled menu; pair it with `onChange`.
props.name: value

props.description: The keys chosen at the start, for an uncontrolled menu.
props.name: defaultValue

props.description: The open state, for a controlled overlay; pair it with `onOpenChange`.
props.name: isOpen

props.description: The starting open state, for an uncontrolled overlay. Native's own name for it is `isDefaultOpen`.
props.name: defaultOpen

props.description: The side of the trigger it opens on, by reading direction. The runtime flips it when there is no room.
props.name: placement

props.description: Where along that side it lines up with the trigger. Defaults to `center`.
props.name: align

props.description: The type of interaction that triggers the menu
props.name: trigger

slots.description: The button or element that triggers the dropdown
slots.name: .dropdown__trigger

slots.description: The menu container inside the popover
slots.name: .dropdown__menu
